subject: Marketplace listing snippet audit + procurement hooks — quick pass
messages:
From: Sally Reed <sally.reed@cloudhealthops.com>

Cc: CloudHealthOps Procurement <procure@cloudhealthops.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick pass: AWS listing snippets + procurement asks

Hi Diego —

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. We're on a tight launch window and I wanted a quick pass on three things you shared: the product page snippets, the procurement footnotes for billing, and the minimal evidence bundle for our security team. We're targeting a soft launch for next Tuesday (11/16) so any turnaround in 24–48 hours would be fantastic.

Specific asks from our side:
- A one-line description and 3 bullets for the AWS product tile that call out latency/cost advantages.
- Pricing footnote language that procurement can drop into an SOW (metering model, invoice cadence, tax/legal contact).
- A compact evidence list for our security team (SOC2 scope, data residency, logs retention, export controls).
- Who at Redwood to tag in the AWS co-sell listing so our GTM team can loop them.

I attached our internal procurement checklist and a first-pass listing draft (listing_copy_v1.docx) — I'll include the procurement team on the thread for any factual clarifications.

Appreciate the quick collaboration.

—Sally
Sally Reed
Head of Cloud Partnerships | CloudHealthOps
Attachments: listing_copy_v1.docx (docx, 42KB); CH_procurement_checklist.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

Kimberly / Marissa —

Forwarding Sally's note from CloudHealthOps — they want a quick pass for an AWS listing and procurement-ready footnotes. Timeline: 24–48h if we can. Proposed split:

- Kimberly: procurement and pricing footnote language + metering phrasing. Key Qs: do we have a private-offer template we can share, and exact invoicing cadence for Reserved vs. usage? Also confirm tax/legal contact line.
- Marissa: field-facing bullets and the three-line tile text (short, benefit-forward). Also prepare two one-paragraph enablement blurbs we can attach to the listing (what to say in outreach and a 60s elevator).
- Diego: I'll consolidate, sanity-check security evidence, and create the AWS tile PDF. I'll also draft the co-sell contact line to include in the listing (who is the Redwood contact for tagging).

Attachments: I'll attach the current asset pack (aws_listing_assets_v2.pdf) once I finish a quick sweep. Please leave inline comments in listing_copy_v2.docx — I'm pushing that to Sally after we agree.

If you can't turn within 24h, call it out and I'll push the ask to the solutions EPD team.

Thanks —
Diego
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 13:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick pass: AWS listing snippets + procurement asks

Diego / Marissa —

I had a quick pass on procurement phrasing. Inline notes below (will add tracked changes in listing_copy_v2.docx):

1) Pricing footnote (suggested):
   - Current: "Usage-based pricing billed monthly per 1,000 tokens"
   - [KIM] Change to: "Usage-based pricing billed monthly, metered per token with per-invoice rounding to the nearest thousand tokens for readability; enterprise Reserved commitments billed per the agreed contract cadence (monthly or annual). Contact billing@redwoodinference.com for tax and invoice questions."

2) Private Offer / DocuSign: we have a private-offer template but it needs minimal redlining for CloudHealthOps. I'll attach the template (pricing_matrix.xlsx will show commitment tiers). Note: Private offers can include a 30–45 day activation SLA only if they commit to a Reserved tier — that's a sales term we'll need to confirm with AC.

3) Evidence list for security (compact):
   - SOC 2 Type II report (attestation; scope: inference platform)
   - Data residency options: US, EU (GovCloud available on request)
   - Audit logs: 90-day console + 1-year export on request (longer retention via Enterprise add-on)
   - Endpoint isolation options for Private deployments (VPC + KMS)
   - Contact for certs: compliance@redwoodinference.com

4) One more footnote for procurement: include a short SLA exception clause reference for marketplace listings: "Marketplace listing performance targets are illustrative; definitive SLAs are defined in the private offer or enterprise contract."

I'll upload the redlined doc in ~2 hours. If Marissa can draft the tile language I can vet the legal/finance phrasing.

-Kim
Director, GTM Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachment (coming): pricing_matrix.xlsx

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com>

Sally —

Thanks — appreciate the clear asks. Quick update and deliverables attached (aws_listing_assets_v2.pdf, pricing_matrix.xlsx, listing_copy_v2.docx). Summary below:

1) Tile & bullets (ready for the AWS product tile):
   - One-liner: "Redwood Inference — predictable, low-latency LLM inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments."
   - Bullets (3):
     • "High-throughput, GPU-optimized runtime for sub-100ms token latency (typical)."
     • "Cost controls: intelligent batching, KV prefix caching, and quantization recommendations to reduce per-token spend."
     • "Deploy anywhere: hosted API, Reserved Dedicated capacity, or Private VPC with KMS."

2) Procurement footnotes (copy you can insert into SOW):
   - "Usage-based pricing billed monthly, metered per token with invoice rounding to the nearest thousand tokens; Reserved capacity commitments billed per contract (monthly or annually). Contact billing@redwoodinference.com for invoicing and tax questions."
   - "Private offers and enterprise SLAs are documented in the private-offer agreement (DocuSign link below). Marketplace listing statements are illustrative; definitive terms supersede via private offer or enterprise contract."

3) Evidence bundle (compact for security review):
   - SOC 2 Type II (inference scope) — Redwood can provide the report under NDA.
   - Data residency options: US and EU; GovCloud and on-premise package available upon request.
   - Audit logging: 90-day UI retention + 1-year export; extended retention via Enterprise add-on.
   - KMS/HSM integrations and VPC isolation options for Private deployments.
   - Contact: compliance@redwoodinference.com for certificate access or to request an evidence bundle.

4) Co-sell contact and next steps:
   - Please tag "g2g@redwoodinference.com" in the AWS listing for co-sell routing — that's our marketplace/co-sell intake.
   - I've attached the updated listing copy (listing_copy_v2.docx) with Kim's procurement redlines and Marissa's field snippets.
   - If you want a private-offer draft, sign the DocuSign private-offer link and we'll turn around a tailored offer within 48 hours once commitment tiers are confirmed.

Attachments included (stubs):
- aws_listing_assets_v2.pdf (PDF, product tile mock + bullets)
- pricing_matrix.xlsx (XLSX, commitment tiers + SLA notes)
- listing_copy_v2.docx (DOCX, redlines and final copy)

Next steps: if this looks good, can you confirm by EOD tomorrow and we'll start the DocuSign private-offer flow? Also confirm who on your GTM should be CC'd for co-sell enablement.

Happy to jump on a 20-min call if you'd prefer to walk through the assets.

Best,
